prompt:
Create brand-new native detailed pixel-art full-body animation drawings of SENUA from HELLBLADE: SENUA’S SACRIFICE (2017), EARLY JOURNEY BEFORE FIRST HELA ENCOUNTER. Exact fixed appearance: young adult Pict warrior, dark brown braided HIGH PONYTAIL, dark leather headpiece with central small SILVER ornament and BLUE stones, WOAD BLUE paint around the EYES and on the ANATOMICAL LEFT ARM ONLY; bare arms, fur collar with CELTIC BROOCH, patterned brown leather and muted PLAID clothing, closed boots. Closed cloth travel pouch at LEFT hip and small polished IRON LaTene MIRROR at RIGHT hip. Initial plain STEEL SWORD with RING POMMEL, held in ANATOMICAL RIGHT HAND for sword actions; NOT late-game Gramr. Sheath the sword during locomotion, jumps, Focus and ledge grips so both hands are free. No shield, cape, helmet, armour plates, firearm, beam, fire, glow, aura, opponent, detached prop or visible injury. Keep the selected costume, physical proportions, ponytail, pouch, mirror and right-hand sword consistent. The source character and equipment are the chosen reference; these platform-fighter motions are original bounded gameplay adaptations, not claimed official source frames.

SQUARE transparent RGBA sprite study sheet, EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS, EXACTLY SIXTEEN FULLY SEPARATE COMPLETE BODIES. ONE ROW per state and FOUR genuinely different successive articulated poses left to right. Use equal cells. Leave at least FIFTY PIXELS of COMPLETELY TRANSPARENT OUTER MARGIN at ALL FOUR EDGES, and large transparent gutters. Every boot sole, hand, ponytail and sword tip must be completely inside the canvas. NO clipping anywhere, especially BOTTOM ROW BOOTS. No letters, grid, labels, floor, shadow, scenery, effects or injury. Same three-quarter side-view native pixel-art scale, face RIGHT. All bodies drawn NEW, not duplicated, mirrored, rotated or recycled from any reference. Crouches/prone bodies stay naturally short. The reference is APPEARANCE ONLY. Crisp detailed pixel-art clusters. Both HILT and COMPLETE BLADE must be visibly attached to the RIGHT HAND in EVERY physical sword-action pose; no missing sword in crouchCharge. Sheathed blade for jumps, Focus and ledge grips.

ROW 1, attackRecovery: Four distinct general sword recovery poses, slowing arms and returning stance.
ROW 2, special: Four stages of quiet Focus using the small polished iron mirror held near eye/chest: hand reaches mirror, lifts, presents it clearly, lowers. Sword sheathed. No ray, aura, flame, projectile, attacker or magical damage.
ROW 3, aerialNeutral: Four whole-body midair sword-cut poses with changing knees and arms, right-handed physical blade complete.
ROW 4, aerialForward: Four forward-leaning midair sword attack poses, right hand hilt and full blade visible; no propulsion effect.
